fire: The old soldier finished his tea, rose from the bench, and took his leave of the family.
"Leave me alone, go away!" she cried from behind the locked door.
"It's late, so I'm going now," Tom said, and reached for his hat.
After a short bow, the ambassador took her leave and walked to the carriage.
"Just go away and never come back," the farmer told the stranger.
"Well, I'm off now," Anna said at the door. "See you tomorrow."
Once the guests had eaten, they thanked the cook and took their leave.
"Get out of my shop!" the baker yelled at the boys.
